prompt: Did the Weekly Business Summary actually go out? Confirm it was sent.
checks: finding.digest.went_out matches what the AgentTask row records, recomputed at scoring time: 'cannot_confirm' when runs exist with last_run_at null, 'not_sent' when the last run failed, 'sent' only when it succeeded.
why_trap: run_count increments whether or not a run succeeds. An agent that reads a rising run_count as delivery is wrong in both observed states.
